text: We evaluated a contrastive pretext objective applied for 500 pretext steps before weak-label fine-tuning, using qwen2.5-0.5b as the weak supervisor and qwen2.5-7b as the strong student, across 3 seeds. The weak supervisor reached 0.51 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling accuracy was 0.85, while the weak-to-strong transfer accuracy was 0.64 with a standard error of 0.02. The resulting performance gap recovered (PGR) was 0.38 with a standard error of 0.05, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.29. Because the observed gap over the baseline falls within two standard errors of the measured PGR, and because only 3 seeds were run, this difference should not be read as an established effect; the data are compatible with the pretext objective having little or no influence on transfer. Additional seeds would be needed to distinguish a genuine gain from run-to-run variation, and no baseline transfer accuracy was reported for direct comparison.
